title: Other Insurer's Daily Payment on Days Carried to a Second Level — Appeals and Grievances Training Sheet
content:
Appeals and Grievances training sheet — other insurer's daily payment for the days carried

Scope: a second-level reconsideration asked for on a decided Medical Necessity Reconsideration of an inpatient mental health authorization.

Rule: The other insurer's daily payment used for the days carried is taken as follows: where other health insurance is on file for the patient and the stay's paid day lines show the other insurer's payments, it is their total divided by the stay's paid covered days; where other health insurance is on file, the stay's lines show none and the earlier admission's lines show one, it is that admission's other-insurer total divided by its covered days; in every other case it is zero; each is rounded to the cent.

Other health insurance is on file when the patient's active TRICARE Select enrollment shows it. The stay's paid day lines are the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines with the line outcome paid, from the facility of the stay's authorization, whose service date is the authorization's first valid day (the admission). The earlier admission is the admission under the patient's Inpatient Mental Health Authorization at the same facility with status expired and the latest first valid day, as shown in Referrals and Authorizations; its first valid day is the admission date, and its paid lines are the patient's paid TRICARE Select lines from that facility with that service date. A line shows the other insurer's payment when the amount other health insurance paid first on it is above zero.

*Other health insurance is on file and the stay's lines show 400.00 over 8 covered days.* 50.00 a day.

*On file, the stay's lines show nothing, the earlier admission's lines show 300.00 over 5 covered days.* 60.00 a day.

*Payments appear on the stay's lines, but no other health insurance is on file.* Zero.

| Other health insurance on file | Stay's paid day lines show payments | Earlier admission's lines show a payment | Daily payment used |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | any | stay's other-insurer total per paid covered day |
| yes | no | yes | earlier admission's other-insurer total per covered day |
| yes | no | no | zero |
| no | any | any | zero |
